quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Sensing that others have information you lack before a meeting even begins — what does this perception create?
quests.explanation: The feeling that others are better informed before a meeting begins creates pre-emptive nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone in the room seems to know something I don't, and the meeting hasn't started yet.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Tense corrections from present to past — what transition of understanding do these corrections reveal?
quests.explanation: Catching yourself using present tense for someone now gone and correcting it is a sign of unprocessed grief.
quests.textToSpeak: He kept correcting his tenses when talking about her. Present to past. He hadn't fully made the switch yet.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Unusual behavior from your most predictable contact — what does this deviation produce?
quests.explanation: Atypical behavior from your most consistent contact with no explanation produces business curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Our most loyal customer placed an unusually large order, paid immediately, and has gone completely quiet since.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'That might be why' about an unplanned best evening — what role does the absence of planning play here?
quests.explanation: An unplanned evening being the best in years suggests that removing expectation produced genuine happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I didn't plan the evening, and neither did she. That might be why it's the best one we've had in years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A clause you identified as unworkable becoming the core of the new agreement — what does this produce?
quests.explanation: Being ignored, then seeing your rejected concern become the central flaw of the outcome, produces anger.
quests.textToSpeak: It appears the clause I raised as unworkable has become the entire foundation of the revised agreement.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A written-off project reappearing as a cited success three years later — what does this reversal produce?
quests.explanation: A project abandoned as a loss reappearing as a success story is a cause of genuine professional surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The project we wrote off as a sunk cost came back as a case study in the industry report three years later.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Identical notes in identical meetings on the same agenda across an entire year — what state has this created?
quests.explanation: Year-long repetition of identical content in recurring meetings is a cause of deep, structural boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: I've been taking the same notes in the same meeting for the same recurring agenda since the beginning of the year.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A forty-three-word statement as the only public explanation for a significant departure — what does its brevity signal?
quests.explanation: An unusually brief, opaque statement following a significant departure produces curiosity about what's behind it.
quests.textToSpeak: She resigned, referred questions to a statement, and has not been reachable since. The statement was forty-three words.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'The results already made the argument' — what posture is the speaker taking toward defending their work?
quests.explanation: Letting a track record stand as its own argument without needing to make the case expresses total confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: My record on this speaks for itself. I don't need to make the argument — the results already made it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A yearly ritual of holding but not reading a letter — what does knowing it by heart from holding suggest?
quests.explanation: A letter held but not re-read because it's already internalized describes a grief maintained across years.
quests.textToSpeak: Every year on this day I open the same drawer and hold the letter. I never read it again. I don't need to.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Finally building the thing we promised' after fourteen months — what moment does this final approval mark?
quests.explanation: Fourteen months of preparation collapsing into a single approval moment produces a surge of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The board approved the final proposal. Fourteen months of work and we're finally building the thing we promised.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being asked to present unfamiliar findings with twenty minutes' notice — what does this situation produce?
quests.explanation: Presenting someone else's work you haven't read with minimal warning is an acute cause of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've been asked to present findings I didn't write. Nobody told me this until twenty minutes ago.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Ignored data being retrospectively cited as the reason for the failure it predicted — what is this dynamic?
quests.explanation: Being told to ignore evidence that then becomes the official cause of the resulting problem produces anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The data was clear. The decision was made anyway. Now the data we were told to ignore is being cited as the cause.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Three departures coinciding with an unannounced restructuring and no public comment — what does this suggest?
quests.explanation: Three simultaneous senior departures with no public statement around a private restructuring is a surprising pattern.
quests.textToSpeak: Three senior leaders left the same week the quiet restructuring plan was circulated. Nobody commented publicly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Crying during good news on a call — what does the involuntary physical response to good news tell you?
quests.explanation: Crying while receiving good news, unable to function, is a description of happiness too large to contain.
quests.textToSpeak: I got the call while I was cooking dinner. I had to turn the gas off because I couldn't hold the pan and cry at the same time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: One abstention, an immediate departure, and a subsequent absence from all meetings — what pattern is this?
quests.explanation: A single dissent followed by departure and absence suggests a story behind the abstention that invites curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The vote was unanimous except for one abstention, from a member who left immediately after and hasn't attended since.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An hour on two sentences you still haven't sent — what makes such a short message so difficult?
quests.explanation: An hour spent on two sentences that still may not be sent reveals the nervousness of high-stakes communication.
quests.textToSpeak: It took me an hour to write a two-sentence text. And I still haven't decided if I'll actually send it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A kept, unwashed jumper from someone's cleared room — what does refusing to wash it preserve?
quests.explanation: Keeping a garment unwashed to preserve a person's scent is a quiet act of grief and sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I cleared his room this spring. I kept one jumper. It still smells right. I don't wash it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Describing the presentation as unnecessary because the results have already done the work — what is this?
quests.explanation: Treating a presentation as a formality because your track record has already made the case is pure confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I don't need the presentation to persuade them. The past three years of results already persuaded them.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A retrospective that starts slowly and ends by recommending the status quo — what has it actually produced?
quests.explanation: A retrospective that ends by recommending no change after a slow start is a description of wasted time — boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: Our team retrospective began with a thirty-minute icebreaker and ended with a commitment to 'keep doing what we're doing.'

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A month-long review finished in one afternoon with no published conclusions — what does this produce?
quests.explanation: A process that ends far faster than expected with no stated outcome is a cause of genuine surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The internal review expected to last a month concluded in a single afternoon with no stated findings.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'It's done' after fourteen months of work the field said was impossible — what milestone is this?
quests.explanation: Completing research described as impossible and seeing your name in the published paper is pure excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: My name is in the published paper. Fourteen months of research the field said couldn't be done. It's done.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being required to use an unconsulted, inferior replacement — what does forced substitution without input produce?
quests.explanation: Being compelled to use a worse tool built without your input to replace a working one produces anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The tool was built without consulting the team that uses it. Now we're required to use it instead of the one that worked.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The same question producing a different answer from every senior leader — what does this inconsistency raise?
quests.explanation: No consistent answer from leadership to the same strategic question produces organizational curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Every senior leader in the company uses a different phrase to answer the same question about their five-year plan.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Saved messages read for the specific quality of how someone wrote — what attachment does this habit reveal?
quests.explanation: Reading saved messages to remember someone's writing style is a quiet, sustained expression of grief.
quests.textToSpeak: He still has the messages from before she died. He told me he reads them sometimes to remember how she wrote.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A failure location revisited and found to be ordinary — what does finding it 'fine' measure?
quests.explanation: Returning to a place of failure and finding it ordinary measures the distance you've traveled since — happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I went back to the place where my worst professional failure happened and ordered the same coffee. It tasted fine.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being responsible for explaining a decision that will affect half your audience — what does this position create?
quests.explanation: Being the person required to explain a decision that hurts half the room produces acute nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: The announcement will affect half the people in this room and I'm the one who has to stand up and explain why.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A behavioral change by an algorithm coinciding with six new contacts on the same day — what does this raise?
quests.explanation: A platform behavior change coinciding precisely with a network expansion raises questions of curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The algorithm changed its recommendation for me on the same day six people from very different networks became my contacts.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Positive feedback paired with rejection, with no explanation offered — what does this combination produce?
quests.explanation: Positive assessment followed by rejection with no reason given produces a specific kind of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The feedback was positive. The opportunity was given to someone else. No explanation was offered or considered necessary.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The loudest defender of a practice revealing themselves as its whistle-blower — what does this reversal produce?
quests.explanation: The chief defender of something revealing themselves as its reporter is a cause of genuine surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The whistleblower turned out to be the person who had been most visible in defending the very practices they reported.
